steps.text: Hello, little chefs! I'm Chef Maya. Let's make a crispy golden masala dosa!
Wash your hands first. Always ask a grown-up to help with the hot stove and utensils.
We have our smooth dosa batter, warm potato filling, and fresh coconut chutney ready.
Our grown-up warms the pan. Gently pour a ladle of batter right into the middle.
Use the bottom of the ladle. Spread the batter outwards in smooth, gentle spirals.
Drizzle a little oil around the edges and watch the dosa turn crispy and golden.
Spoon the delicious potato masala onto one half of our golden dosa.
Slide the spatula underneath and gently fold the crispy half over the yummy filling.
Slide our warm masala dosa onto the plate. Great cooking, little chefs!
